title: Cover acceptance-submission settlement against concurrent authority operations, the locked second root check end to end, and workdir (source_claim) targets
outcome: Tests and documentation show how submission-time authority settlement interacts with a concurrent admission reconcile, a naming request or a maintenance recovery holding the previous owner. Tests also show the retryable refusal from the locked check in begin_acceptance_evaluation_submission through a real submission, and settlement for an evaluation requested with no named root.
acceptance: Cover acceptance-submission settlement against concurrent authority operations, the locked second root check end to end, and workdir (source_claim) targets is done
